title: Remove app background/gradient from post-Yes celebration screen

requirements.summary: Ensure the post-Yes (celebration) view does not render the app gradient/floating-particles background while keeping the pre-Yes background unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the user clicks the Yes button and the celebration screen is shown, the page background behind the celebration content is not the app gradient background.
The initial floating-particles background is not visible on the celebration screen.
No background styling regressions occur on the initial (pre-Yes) screen: it still displays the current background/animation as before.

file_operations.description: Update the celebration-state container styling (e.g., .app-container.celebrated) to remove/disable the gradient background so the celebration screen shows a non-gradient/neutral background (or transparent to the body background), while leaving the default .app-container gradient and InitialBackgroundAnimation behavior unchanged for the pre-Yes screen.
